## Agent commerce (x402)
Networks: solana-mainnet-beta, eip155:8453 (Base)
Header: X-PAYMENT
Catalog: GET/POST https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/x402-products
Suite job: POST https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/x402-suite
Starter SKU: try-gate (~$9)
Flow: discover → list SKUs → POST buy → 402 accepts[] → pay exact USDC → retry with X-PAYMENT → order_id + access_url
